consent.washingtonConsentBanner: Online tracking technologies, such as cookies, are important for the correct functioning of our website. Based on regulatory changes in the state of Washington, we are excluding the use of nonessential third party cookies on webforms directed to residents within the state of Washington. You can see more information by clicking on the "Cookie Settings" link.Washington Privacy Notice
consent.californiaConsentBanner: Online tracking technologies, such as cookies, are important for the correct functioning of our website. By clicking "Allow All" you are also directing us to use the tracking technologies of other organizations. You can configure your preferences, and see a list of other organization's technologies, by clicking on the "Cookie Settings" link.California Privacy Notice
consent.washingtonEmailConsent: I consent to receive marketing texts and other communications by email from Anytime Fitness Franchisor LLC (“Anytime”). I further agree that Anytime may share my email information but not my phone or text information with its affiliates, franchisees and/or their authorized designees. I can withdraw my consent at any time.
consent.washingtonTextConsent: I'd like to receive promotional offers by text from Anytime, its affiliates, and/or franchisees and their authorized designees, which may be sent by an automated dialing system. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message and data rates apply.
consent.privacyNotice: By clicking “Submit” below, I consent to receive marketing texts and other communications that may be automated and/or placed with artificial voice, placed by or on behalf of Anytime Fitness Franchisor LLC (“Anytime”) and/or Anytime-brand franchisees, even if my phone number is on a state or national Do Not Call list. Anytime will not share my phone or text information with other affiliates. Further, in clicking “Submit”, I agree to accept the Terms & Conditions, Privacy Notice, and Text Messaging Terms, and attest that I am 18 years of age or older. My consent to receive communications is not a condition of purchase, and I can withdraw my consent at any time. Recurring communications. Message and data rates apply. Text STOP to stop. Add Text HELP for assistance.
consent.contactUsPrivacyNotice: Please review if you are a California resident: For information regarding the categories of personal information collected about you, and the purposes for which your information will be used, please visit Anytime Fitness, LLC's Privacy Notice for California Residents.
consent.localResidentDisclaimerText: By clicking "Submit", I acknowledge that I have read and understood the Privacy Notice and consent to the collection, use, disclosure and processing of my personal data by AF24 Fitness Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. ("Anytime Fitness"), its relevant affiliates, franchisees and service providers for the purposes described in the Privacy Notice. I further confirm that I am 18 years of age or older and agree to the Terms and Conditions and Text Messaging Terms. I understand that my personal data may be transferred to and processed by Anytime Fitness's affiliates, franchisees and service providers located outside Malaysia, subject to appropriate safeguards and in accordance with the Privacy Notice.
consent.marketingConsentDisclaimerText: I agree to receive marketing, promotional and other communications (including promotions, offers, events and updates) from Anytime Fitness, its relevant affiliates and franchisees via SMS, phone call, email, WhatsApp and other electronic messaging channels. Such communications may be sent using automated systems. My consent to receive such communications is voluntary and is not a condition of purchase or membership. I may withdraw my consent at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions in the communication or by contacting Anytime Fitness using the contact details set out in the Privacy Notice.
